items.title: Separate virtual units game in Picks
items.state: D-18 confirms a fourth, separate play-money game under Picks. A player uses simple side and unit buttons for Spread or Over/Under. Show the most favorable point line from the most recently accessible named-book quotes across available books, using better payout odds only among equal point lines; show actual book, odds and quote age, with consensus separately. An unavailable refresh does not automatically hide the latest saved quote, and players need not type a line or odds. Sean rejected an age cutoff for this virtual game: before kickoff, players may use the latest retained named-book quote for the applicable game and market even if app refresh fails or a successful refresh omits that book’s market. Newer saved quotes from other books still compete for the best point line; show source/age labels and exact saved terms. If no named-book quote has ever been saved for a matchup’s spread or total, only that market’s virtual-pick button is disabled until a genuine quote is saved; other markets remain open and consensus is not substituted. Newer eligible saved quotes update offered buttons; placed picks stay fixed unless edited. Sean confirmed newer saved named-book quotes update the lines and odds offered in pick buttons; an already placed pick retains its saved line and odds unless the player edits before kickoff. They stake 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3 or another permitted number of units; 1 unit represents $100 virtual. Each matchup permits at most one spread and one total virtual pick, with no repeat within the same market. There is no starting bankroll or cap; no stake fails for insufficient virtual balance. First placement and edits remain open right up until that specific game's kickoff, superseding the earlier one-hour edit cutoff; earlier terms remain in an audit. A postponement staying on the same America/Los_Angeles calendar date carries the saved line, odds and units to the revised kickoff. A move to another Pacific calendar date voids old picks, returns virtual stakes, allows fresh picks and requires an in-app notice plus opt-in push/email when connected. Store kickoff timestamps in UTC for evidence and show Pacific dates to players. During an automated schedule-feed outage, the commissioner may revise kickoff only from a verifiable official league notice, saving its link/time, commissioner identity, old/new kickoff and an immutable change audit. The revised schedule changes the pick deadline, never result grading. A possible cancellation or no contest leaves picks pending while status is uncertain. Only a permitted official confirmation voids them, returns virtual stakes, preserves original qualification credit and triggers affected-player notices through the agreed channels. Weekly qualification requires at least three placed picks OR at least 3 units staked that week. An unreplaced voided pick retains its original pick and unit credit toward weekly qualification, but does not waive the whole threshold. A replacement for the same matchup and market in the same competition week counts as one qualifying pick at the replacement unit stake, even when lower than the voided original. If the rescheduled game moves into a different competition week, the voided original retains its pick/unit qualification credit in its original week; a fresh pick counts only in the new week at its own unit stake. Voided virtual stakes are returned and excluded from settled ROI. Below both thresholds, the week is unqualified for weekly standings but its picks still count in the player's personal overall record and ROI. Net units use the saved American odds; ROI divides total net units by units risked on settled picks. Only a permitted verified automatic final-score feed may grade virtual picks; no such feed is connected yet, so results remain pending until it is. A verified corrected final from that feed regrades affected picks whenever received, even after weekly standings appear, with append-only before/after audit, recomputed record, net units, ROI and standings, and affected-player notice. Track this game's own pending, win, loss, push and void counts, risked units, net units, ROI and W-L-P by week, season and market. The existing personal journal is for user-reported actual bets and does not implement this game. Existing cloud odds normalization stores provider-market observation and collection times for honest age labels; existing provider collection and Challenge quote receipts enforce separate five-minute freshness gates that must not be loosened by this new game. No virtual units game code or cloud release exists. Recommended defaults for Q20-Q30 are recorded in the scoped task list but remain proposals, not confirmed D-18 rules.

decisions.title: What does a blind prediction mean?
decisions.context: The current game awards accuracy for matching the sportsbook benchmark. A guess of that benchmark is different from a personal forecast of the actual winning margin or combined score. The difference between a guess and a market line is not automatically expected value.
decisions.prompt: For both spread and total, should the entry predict the sportsbook number, your own expected game outcome, or should those be separate values?

options.label: Separate values — recommended
options.detail: Keep the existing market-guess competition; optionally record a separate personal fair spread/total for analysis. Use independently sourced models for advice.

options.label: Market guess only
options.detail: Keep one fast entry. Treat its difference from the market as a comparison signal; let outside models provide outcome projections.

options.label: Personal outcome forecast
options.detail: Use expected winning margin/combined points. This changes the meaning of the game and needs a follow-up scoring decision before implementation.

answer.label: Separate market guesses and optional personal fair projections
answer.detail: Guess the Spread and Guess the Total continue to score guesses of the sportsbook benchmark. An optional separate forecast of the expected winning margin or combined score supports personal analysis alongside independently sourced models. Personal forecasts do not overwrite competition guesses or create an unsupported EV claim.

decisions.title: Over/Under dashboard parity

answer.label: Over/Under should be treated similarly to Spread and show provisional results before line lock
answer.detail: Add independent submitted-Total provisional accuracy, gaps, opponents and real recorded history; preserve immutable picks and separate official scoring policy/freeze.

decisions.title: Icon-only Field monogram

answer.label: Use the selected Field monogram without adjacent text
answer.detail: Apply rounded lime tile, dark original glyph and soft shadow in product brand placements. Keep Guess The Line as browser title and accessible name.

answer.label: Separate Best Bets competition
answer.detail: Best Bets is a separate optional confidence-weighted competition. Guess the Spread and Guess the Total retain existing full-slate accuracy rules and immutable submitted ballots. Numerical weights, budget, timing and settlement remain unresolved.

decisions.title: Submission-time scoring and edit references
decisions.summary: Confirmed in the current voice session; implementation and delivery tracked separately.
decisions.context: Sean requested running player comparisons and timestamped comparisons of selections with odds. Analysis at the time of a decision is separate from deciding the official competition reference.
decisions.prompt: Confirmed: individual submission-time references, updated only for changed guesses on edit.

answer.label: Individual submission-time scoring; changed guesses re-anchor at edit
answer.detail: Score Spread and Total against each player’s consensus captured at full submission. Save a fresh reference only for changed submitted guesses before the existing deadline; keep other references and original submission time. Show current consensus separately and compare players with their individual reference times. Preserve historical files/audits and show missing historical evidence rather than inventing it. This supersedes the permanent Spread/Total submission lock; Challenge and group privacy remain unchanged.
answer.userResponse: Scoring should be based on the line at the time of the guesses; when asked whether an edit uses consensus at the edit: yes. it should.

decisions.title: Sourced quote fallback and simple pick controls

answer.label: Use the best line from the most recently accessible named-book quotes
answer.detail: For each Spread or Total side, show an automatically selected book line from the latest accessible saved quotes, with book, odds and observation/collection age. A failed refresh alone does not hide a retained quote. Keep consensus separate as comparison data and use simple side/unit buttons so manual line entry is not required. The line-versus-odds ranking is the next decision; no claim of live pricing or shipped UI is implied.
answer.userResponse: It should show the best line and spread from the most recently accessible lines and spreads from any of the books. Do you understand? It should be VERY simple for people to make picks and stuff using buttons

decisions.title: Best book line ranking for virtual picks

answer.label: Prioritize the better point line
answer.detail: For the selected side, automatically use the most favorable spread or total threshold among the latest accessible named-book quotes. Use better payout odds among equal point lines. Show the chosen book, odds and quote age; this is a selection rule, not a proven expected-value ranking.

decisions.title: Virtual payout and unit ROI formula

answer.label: Use saved American odds
answer.detail: Each unit is $100 virtual risked. Compute winning net units from the American odds saved with that pick; a loss is negative staked units, and a push returns the stake for zero net. ROI is total net units divided by settled units risked; pending and void picks are excluded.

decisions.title: Automatic final-score settlement

answer.label: Automatic verified final-score feed only
answer.detail: Virtual Spread and Total picks remain pending until a permitted automatic NFL final-score source supplies a verified result. Commissioner-entered scores are not a settlement fallback for this mode. Retain source and correction history; no automatic feed is connected or live settlement verified yet.

decisions.title: Same-day postponement treatment

answer.label: Carry saved picks if the game remains on the same day
answer.detail: When a verified schedule change delays kickoff within the same calendar day, keep existing virtual Spread and Total picks at their saved line, odds and units. Preserve the original quote/audit and move the game-specific edit deadline to the revised kickoff. A different-day move and calendar timezone convention remain open.
answer.userResponse: Carry over if it’s on the same day

decisions.title: Different-day postponement treatment

answer.label: Void old picks and notify affected players
answer.detail: When verified schedule evidence moves a matchup to another calendar day, void its old virtual picks, return their virtual stakes, preserve the audit and let players choose again at the rescheduled market. Notify affected players; channel and void qualification accounting remain to be decided. No actual notification delivery is connected by this decision.

decisions.title: Notification channels for different-day voids

answer.label: Persistent in-app, opt-in push and opt-in email
answer.detail: Notify affected players through all three offered channels when a different-day postponement voids their virtual picks: a persistent in-app notice plus push and email for players who opt in, once those delivery paths are connected and verified. This does not authorize or establish SMS, external delivery, or consent collection.

decisions.title: Voided-pick weekly qualification credit

answer.label: Count original pick and units, without full-week waiver
answer.detail: A voided virtual pick retains its original pick count and staked-unit amount toward that week’s three-pick-or-3-unit qualification threshold. One voided 1-unit pick therefore counts as one pick and one unit, and does not automatically qualify the entire week. The returned stake remains excluded from settled ROI. Separate credit for a fresh replacement is still open.

decisions.title: Qualification credit for a replacement after a void

answer.label: One pick and one unit for equal-stake replacement
answer.detail: When a voided 1-unit spread pick is replaced by a fresh 1-unit spread pick for the same NFL matchup and market in the same competition week, count one qualifying pick and 1 unit, not two picks and 2 units. A different replacement stake remains unresolved. Voided stake is returned and excluded from settled ROI.

decisions.title: Unit credit when a replacement stake changes

answer.label: Use replacement units
answer.detail: For a same-week replacement of a voided pick in the same matchup and market, count one qualifying pick at the replacement unit stake only, even if lower than the original. If no replacement is placed, keep the original voided pick and unit credit. The original virtual stake is returned and excluded from settled ROI.

decisions.title: Aged retained quote at virtual-pick placement

answer.label: Allow the 18-hour-old retained quote in the stated case
answer.detail: If refresh is unavailable, the latest named-book quote for the selected market is 18 hours old, and the game has not kicked off, keep virtual placement available using that quote. Show the actual book and quote age and save the exact terms. A general maximum age or unlimited-age policy is not yet decided.

decisions.title: What updates when a newer sportsbook line is saved

answer.label: Update offered buttons only
answer.detail: When a newer eligible named-book quote is saved, update the line and odds offered in the simple pick buttons. An already placed virtual pick retains its saved line and odds unless the player explicitly edits that pick before the matchup kickoff. Keep an audit of edits. This does not answer the maximum age for a retained quote when no newer quote exists.

decisions.title: Maximum age for retained virtual-pick quotes

answer.label: No age cutoff for virtual picks on a saved named-book line
answer.detail: Before the specific matchup kicks off, a new virtual pick may use the latest retained named-book quote for the applicable game and market even when quote collection is delayed. Do not disable placement solely because the saved quote is older than 24 hours. Show the actual source, observation/collection time and prominent age; save exact historical terms and never present the quote as a current executable offer. Newer eligible saved quotes update offered buttons; already placed picks retain their saved terms unless explicitly edited. This does not authorize invented lines or answer the no-saved-quote case.
answer.userResponse: Well, we should be able to allow new picks. No matter what ... just because there’s an issue on our end, doesn’t mean that they shouldn’t be able to make picks.

decisions.title: Saved quote when a refresh omits that book’s market

answer.label: Keep the retained named-book quote selectable
answer.detail: Before kickoff, a successful refresh omitting a book’s market does not remove its last saved applicable quote from virtual-pick buttons. Show the saved book, observation/collection time and prominent age, and never imply the book currently offers it. A newer saved quote from another book still competes under the best-point-line and odds tie-break rules. Existing placed picks remain fixed unless explicitly edited before kickoff. This interpretation of “Continue” can be revised if Sean clarifies otherwise.

decisions.title: No saved named-book quote for a market

answer.label: Disable only the unavailable market
answer.detail: If no named-book quote has ever been saved for a matchup’s spread or total, disable only that market’s virtual-pick button until a genuine named-book quote is saved. Other available games and markets remain usable. Do not fabricate line or odds terms or silently treat consensus as a book quote.

decisions.title: Cancelled or abandoned matchup

answer.label: Keep pending until verified; then void and notify
answer.detail: A possible cancellation or no contest leaves affected virtual picks pending while status is uncertain. Only permitted official confirmation of cancellation or no contest voids those picks, returns virtual stakes, preserves their original pick/unit weekly qualification credit and triggers affected-player notices through the agreed channels. Unconfirmed reports do not settle or void picks. The specific source and its access remain to be verified.

decisions.title: Corrected final score after settlement

answer.label: Automatically grade and regrade verified finals
answer.detail: The permitted verified automatic final-score feed grades the initial final and regrades affected virtual picks whenever it verifies a corrected final, including after weekly standings appear. Preserve original saved line, odds and units; append a before/after audit, recompute W-L-P, net units, ROI and standings, and notify affected players. Commissioner-entered corrections do not grade this game. The feed is not connected or verified yet.
answer.userResponse: So it automatically grades the... result, is that what you’re saying? [Assistant: Yes, it grades and regrades from the permitted automatic feed.] Yeah

decisions.title: Calendar timezone for postponements

answer.label: Pacific calendar for same-day versus different-day moves
answer.detail: Compare original and revised kickoff dates in America/Los_Angeles to decide whether a postponement carries saved virtual picks or voids them. Store actual kickoff timestamps in UTC for evidence and display Pacific dates to players. This does not prove that a schedule-change or actual-kickoff source is connected.

decisions.title: Replacement after a move to another competition week

answer.label: Keep qualification credit in each pick’s competition week
answer.detail: When a rescheduled game moves to a different competition week, the voided original keeps its pick/unit qualification credit in its original week. A fresh pick for the rescheduled game counts only in the new competition week at its own unit stake. Do not transfer the old credit or combine stakes across weeks. Same-week replacement deduplication remains unchanged.

decisions.title: Schedule update when the automatic feed is unavailable

answer.label: Allow sourced commissioner kickoff revision during feed outage
answer.detail: During an automated schedule-feed outage, the commissioner may enter a revised kickoff only from a verifiable official league notice. Save the notice URL and time, commissioner identity, prior and revised kickoff, and immutable change history. This updates the virtual-pick deadline but does not grade any result; grading remains limited to a permitted verified automatic final-score feed. Source access and implementation remain unverified.

confirmedDecisions.question: What if a pick is later proven to have been placed after actual kickoff because status data lagged?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: Void that invalid late pick, return its virtual stake, exclude it from ROI **and weekly qualification**, retain the placement/correction audit and notify the player. Keep valid pre-kickoff picks intact.

confirmedDecisions.question: What if play starts, then the game is suspended and resumes later, even on another day?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: Never reopen new picks or edits after the first verified actual kickoff. Keep already valid picks pending through a verified resumption and grade the eventual final; use the confirmed cancellation/no-contest void rule only if the game is officially cancelled or declared no contest. The confirmed different-day *pre-kickoff* postponement rule does not silently govern an in-progress suspension.

confirmedDecisions.question: Which quote can support a fresh pick after a different-day reschedule?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: Require a saved named-book quote mapped to the verified rescheduled event and market. Do not recycle the voided event's old line merely because this game has no quote-age cutoff. If the rescheduled event has no saved quote, disable only that market until one is saved. Preserve the old event/quote audit.

confirmedDecisions.question: What happens when a player edits a placed pick, including only its units?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: Show the best currently offered saved line and odds, require explicit confirmation of the entire revised side/line/odds/units, then save a new immutable revision. Never silently reprice the previously placed pick.

confirmedDecisions.question: Can a player withdraw a pick and place another in the same matchup/market?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: In the first version, use the confirmed pre-kickoff edit path to change side, line and units within the one existing pick slot. Do not add a withdraw-and-replace action that could contradict the confirmed no-repeat-pick rule; preserve each edit in the audit.

confirmedDecisions.question: How do simple unit buttons work above the 3U preset without a stake cap?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: Keep 0.5–3U quick buttons and add clear +0.5U/−0.5U controls for larger positive half-unit stakes. Show the $100-per-unit virtual risk and require confirmation. Apply no business bankroll/stake cap; validate exact finite positive half-unit values.

confirmedDecisions.question: How are eligible weekly standings ordered?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: Rank qualifying weeks by ROI, then net units, then wins; share a rank if still tied. Show settled units risked, settled sample and W-L-P beside ROI. A qualified week with no settled picks shows pending/ROI unavailable rather than a fabricated 0% rank.

confirmedDecisions.question: Are virtual picks copied per group or visible to other players before kickoff?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: Use one account-level virtual pick per game/market, reused in every eligible group; calculate each group's standings from its roster. Show a player's own picks immediately and other players' picks after that matchup kicks off, unless the player explicitly shares sooner. Do not expose private journal or hidden Guess ballots.

confirmedDecisions.question: Which week owns a pick when a game is moved?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: Use the canonical NFL competition season/week from the verified schedule, not a Monday–Sunday calendar week. Keep the original voided pick's credit in its original competition week; assign a fresh rescheduled pick to the verified new competition week.

confirmedDecisions.question: How are otherwise equal book offers selected?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: After the confirmed best-point-line and better-odds rules, prefer the most recently observed applicable quote; use a stable book-key tie-break if observation times also tie. Save the chosen source and timestamps so the button does not flicker between equivalent offers.

confirmedDecisions.question: Which channels carry a late-pick or corrected-result notice?
confirmedDecisions.recommendation: Use a persistent in-app notice, plus push and email only for players who opted into each connected channel. Preserve an event receipt and do not imply delivery until verified.
